meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会直接向外部 API 发 HTTP 请求,网关在代理边界自动注入已连接服务的凭证,它不接触密钥值。可用来取回邮件、日历、GitHub、Stripe 等服务的真实数据,无需自己填 auth 头。
howto.when: 当你要求读取邮件、查看日历或访问 GitHub 等外部服务与 API 时接管;若该服务尚未连接,它会返回一个连接链接让你去连。

say.note: 直接调 API,不用加认证头

say.text: 查一下 Stripe 最近的支付记录

howto.what_en: Claude makes HTTP requests straight to external APIs; the gateway injects credentials for connected services at the proxy boundary, so it never sees key values. It can fetch real data from mail, calendar, GitHub, Stripe and more, with no auth headers.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask it to read email, check your calendar, or access GitHub and other external services or APIs. If a service isn't connected, it returns a connect link.
